product.olivetti-philos-22.summary: The monochrome configuration in the Philos 22 line.
product.olivetti-philos-22.history: Olivrea’s brochure index records an Olivetti brochure for the Philos 22 and 22 Color. In November 1994, Ok Data advertised the 22 in Norway at NOK 9,850 including tax.
product.olivetti-philos-22.architecture: The floppy drive could be purchased separately. Ok Data’s offer listed 4 MB RAM, an 85 MB disk and a 25 MHz 486 DX.
product.olivetti-philos-22.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-22.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-22.index: Olivrea, index of Olivetti portable brochures, Philos 22 and 22 Color.
